runChips.label: Memory use
runChips.writeTip: Opens the entry this run wrote last.
runChips.readTip: Shows the read events in the event table.

title: Memory

tags.placeholder: Type a tag, then press Enter
tags.truncated: Only some tags are shown. Type to find the rest.

detail.emptyHint: Select an entry to see it here.
detail.notInFilter: This entry doesn't match the current filters.
detail.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or the address is wrong.
detail.saveBlocked: Can't save: over the size limit.

band.redacted: Values that looked like secrets were masked on save. The editor now shows the saved content.
band.saveAsNew: Save my content as a new entry
band.secretTitle: Not saved: part of the content looks like a secret.
band.secretBody: Strings that look like API keys, tokens or passwords can't be saved to memory. We don't say which part. Remove or change anything suspicious, then save again.
band.secretBodyAt: A value that looks like a secret is in the {where}. Remove or change anything suspicious, then save again.
band.tooLarge: Not saved: the content is over the size limit.
band.invalidKey: Not saved: the key doesn't follow the key rules.

newEntry.title: New entry
newEntry.exists: This scope already has an entry with this key

move.title: Move key or scope
move.hint: The entry keeps its id and history. You can't move it if the same scope and key exist.
move.dirty: Unsaved changes aren't moved. Save first.
move.exists: This scope already has an entry with this key

purge.title: Delete permanently
purge.body_one: This deletes the entry, its {count} version and the search index. It can't be undone or recovered from history.
purge.body_other: This deletes the entry, its {count} versions and the search index. It can't be undone or recovered from history.
purge.confirm: I understand this can't be undone

clear.title: Clear scope
clear.step1: This permanently deletes the {n, number} entries in {label} ({archived} archived). Entries marked as deleted are deleted too, and this can't be undone.
clear.typeLabel: To confirm, type the scope name exactly
clear.note: Scope kinds aren't deleted. This scope stays, with no entries.

export.note: Downloads a set of Markdown files (.zip) in the browser. The server doesn't write to a folder.

import.title: Import memory

skip.label: Skip
skip.help: Leaves the existing entry as it is and skips the new one.

overwrite.label: Overwrite
overwrite.help: Writes a new version of the existing entry. You can undo it from history.

rename.label: Add with a new name
rename.help: Adds a number to the key and creates a new entry.

import.note: Imported entries go to the scope named in the file. An entry whose scope kind doesn't exist is reported as an error. Imported entries are checked for secrets and skipped if one is found.
import.undoHint: To undo, restore the previous version from the entry history.
import.cancelNote: Entries the server already applied stay, even if you stop.
import.previewRenamed: To create with a new name: {n}
import.previewNote: The real import may give different results.

history.restoreConfirm: Unsaved changes will be lost. Load this version?

conflict.title: Someone else changed it first
conflict.opened: The version I opened: v{a} → server v{b}
conflict.note: Even if you save your changes, server v{b} stays in the history and you can restore it any time.

store.label: Memory store
store.libraryNote: This is shared memory. Project runs don't use it directly; they use the copy in the project.
store.noProjectNote: There are no projects, so you're viewing shared memory. Project runs use the memory in the project folder.

leave.title: You have unsaved changes.
leave.body: If you leave now, what you're editing may be lost.

state.noKindsBody: Without a scope kind, agents can't write to memory and you can't create entries. Existing entries stay under “Unusable scopes”.
state.emptyBody: Records agents leave during runs, or that people create, are collected here.
state.benefit1: Decisions and findings outlive a run, so the next run can build on them.
state.benefit2: Versions record who changed what and when, and you can restore them.
state.benefit3: Scopes keep entries apart so they don't mix.
state.hintResourceNoType: To let an agent write memory, add a memory kind to its resource.

storageMemory: Memory is running temporarily without a storage file. Everything is lost when the server restarts. Export it to keep a copy.
